module: "Debug Textures" debug section of the Dynamic Decals tool. Shows, in collapsible headers, the internal textures of the editor_api_dynamicDecals API: dynamic, baked, highlight, decal (brush input) and masks. The maximum width of the previews comes from the preference `dynamicDecalsTool.debugTextures.maxImageWidgetWidth` (default 512).
notes: The variable textureSet is never set (its assignment is commented out), so the "Combined Textures" header never appears.

editorPreferenceValueChanged.desc: Hook called when a preference changes. Does nothing here.

setup.desc: Called by the tool: gets the API and registers the "Debug Textures" section (order 1130).
